market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off bias persists. Warsh's hawkish tone keeps rate-hike bets elevated, pressuring equities and EM. Oil and commodities remain bid on Iran conflict. Nasdaq likely to stay range-bound below record. Expect volatility in bonds as market digests Warsh's 'Central Banking 101' framing. 1-3 month: choppy, defensive posture favored.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month: AI capex supercycle (SpaceX, hyperscalers) and solar economic tipping point drive structural growth. Energy transition in China stalls, benefiting traditional coal/energy. EM bonds outperform on dollar debasement. Consumer stress may moderate if inflation cools. Key risk: prolonged rate-hike cycle stalling growth. Debt reckoning concerns (Harvard economist) add tail risk.
